name: Noctua - application stack and deploy via SSM (Docker Hub)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({DocumentName: 'AWS-RunShellScript', InstanceIds: [$json.step.instanceId], Comment: 'Noctua deploy ' + $json.step.component, TimeoutSeconds: 600, Parameters: {commands: $json.step.commands, executionTimeout: ['3600']} }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
if (!$json.done || $json.commandResult?.status !== 'Success' || $json.commandResult.responseCode !== 0) throw new Error('Cannot advance until the command succeeds');
return [{json: {...$json, results: [...$json.results, $json.commandResult], stepIndex: $json.stepIndex + 1}}];

parameters.content:
## 1. Inputs and AWS credential
Configure files/application.local.json with published image digests. Compose mounts application.yaml, scripts/remote_application.py and database/script-noctua.sql. No prepare command needed.

Select the SAME AWS credential (us-east-1 + current session token) in all FOUR HTTP nodes. Create the database SecureString before running. Run only one deployment at a time.

## 2. Provision application.yaml
Checks network exports, secret metadata and optional compute outputs. Validates template, creates/updates the application change set and EXECUTES it automatically. Preserves unmanaged parameters on updates. No-change plans reuse the stack.

Waits for CloudFormation completion AND change-set execution, then all 3 EC2s Online in SSM. Inspect CloudFormation events on failure. Network/NAT and analytics data must already be ready.

## 3. Deploy and validate
Database -> backend -> frontend. Each SSM command must return Success + exit 0. Polling retries eventual consistency/throttling and fails on timeout or command errors.

Remote script also waits for bootstrap-ready. Commands may continue if n8n stops: inspect CommandId before retrying. Final output includes results and logs for all three components.
